response.justification: Strong, broad engineer with genuine high-throughput distributed systems experience (Sociomantic/dunnhumby microservices at millions of requests/second, low-latency async services) and current hands-on work on AI-agent infrastructure including MCP code generators — which maps directly to the AI-native engineering environment. Staff-level titles have been held, and the craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, teaching/workshops) suggests strong engineering judgment and influence. However, Python is absent from the stated skill set while TypeScript is the deep language — the inverse of the requirement — and the resume is thin on explicit technical-strategy ownership at scale, cross-functional stakeholder management, on-call/incident response, and agile ceremony leadership. Recent roles skew full-stack product and generalist breadth rather than distributed-systems depth. Worth an interview to probe Python depth and scope of technical leadership.
strengths: Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience at ad-tech scale
Current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP/developer tooling work
Exceptional technical breadth plus strong testing/craftsmanship and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: Python not listed anywhere; primary depth is TypeScript/D
Little evidence of technical strategy at scale or cross-functional stakeholder management
No stated on-call, incident-response, or formal agile/scrum ownership experience

key_factors.factor: AI-agent tooling and agentic workflow experience
